message:
You are more than just a church leader to us—you are a dear and trusted friend. We’re truly grateful for the friendship we’ve built and for the way you have been part of our church family.

We know that you’ll soon be starting a new chapter in Korea for work, and that means we may not get to have you with us as often as we would like. That’s why we’re especially grateful that you accepted to be one of Caleb’s godparents.

We know you may not be able to attend his celebration, but if you’re able to be there, it would make the occasion even more special for us. Either way, we’re just thankful that you said yes and accepted this role in Caleb’s life.

As you begin this new journey, we pray that God will guide you, protect you, and bless you wherever He leads you. May He continue to use you in your work and ministry, and may you always be reminded that you have friends here who will be praying for you.

We’re truly happy to have you as part of Caleb’s journey, and we’re grateful that even as life takes you somewhere new, you will always have a special place in our family’s heart.
